latest_release.body:
### Security
- **Fix command injection in the analytics Console Bridge** (port 3334) —
  GHSA-4jm9-m3fr-9jpx, reported by @manus-pi. Affected 1.11.0 through
  1.29.6. Terminal input is spawned with argv and passed through the
  environment instead of interpolated into `expect`/`osascript` source, the
  macOS `do script` fallback is removed, and the WebSocket handshake now
  requires a loopback peer, the local dashboard origin and a per-process token.
- **Same class, found by the follow-up audit**: `--health-check`,
  `--command-stats`, `--hook-stats`, `--mcp-stats`, global agent wrappers and
  `--clone-session` no longer pass text from project files, downloaded
  components or arguments through a shell. The Claude API proxy (port 3335)
  binds to loopback and refuses browser and non-loopback requests. A setting
  component can only write files under `.claude/`.

### Changed
- Mods: removed the early-access warning and the
  `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS` instruction; Claude Code 2.1.287+ loads
  mods by default.

detail.readme:
Claude Code Templates

An open catalog of components for Claude Code, installable with one command.

Browse the catalog  ·  Documentation  ·  Contributing  ·  Discussions  ·  Changelog

SPONSORED BY

Swiftproxy proudly supports this project.
Connect your AI-powered workflows to reliable residential proxies for web data collection, browser automation, and AI-driven research.
90M+ residential IPs across 220+ locations, rotating and static residential proxies, with HTTP(S) and SOCKS5 support.

## About Claude Code is configured through small files: skills, subagents, slash commands, hooks, MCP servers and settings. Claude Code Templates collects more than 1,980 of them in one catalog at [aitmpl.com](https://www.aitmpl.com), where you can search, preview every file a component writes, and combine several components into a single install command. The CLI writes each file to the right place and merges existing configuration instead of overwriting it. Every pull request is checked by Claude Code's plugin validator and scanned by [NVIDIA SkillSpector](https://github.com/NVIDIA/skillspector). ## Quickstart Runs with `npx`, no global install needed. ```bash # Browse the catalog and install interactively npx claude-code-templates@latest # Install one component npx claude-code-templates@latest --skill creative-design/frontend-design # Install a stack in one command npx claude-code-templates@latest \ --agent development-team/frontend-developer \ --command testing/generate-tests \ --mcp integration/github-integration ``` Add `--yes` to skip the confirmation prompt. Every component page on [aitmpl.com](https://www.aitmpl.com) shows its exact install command. To find one from the terminal: `npx claude-code-templates@latest --search "code review"`.
One example per component type ```bash npx claude-code-templates@latest --skill creative-design/frontend-design npx claude-code-templates@latest --agent development-tools/code-reviewer npx claude-code-templates@latest --command performance/optimize-bundle-size npx claude-code-templates@latest --mcp database/postgresql-integration npx claude-code-templates@latest --setting mcp/mcp-timeouts npx claude-code-templates@latest --hook git/conventional-commits npx claude-code-templates@latest --mod security/secret-redactor # Claude Code 2.1.287+ npx claude-code-templates@latest --loop engineering/docs-sweep-loop # also installs the components the loop uses npx claude-code-templates@latest --plugin productivity/champion-kit # via the aitmpl marketplace, Claude Code 2.1.288+ ```
## What's in the catalog | Type | Count | What it is | Examples | |------|------:|------------|----------| | **Skills** | 918 | Reusable capabilities with progressive disclosure | PDF processing, frontend design, code review | | **Agents** | 422 | Subagents specialized in one domain | Security auditor, frontend developer, database architect | | **Commands** | 288 | Custom slash commands | `/generate-tests`, `/optimize-bundle-size`, `/security-audit` | | **MCPs** | 119 | External service integrations | GitHub, PostgreSQL, Stripe, Supabase, Sentry | | **Settings** | 80 | Claude Code configuration | Timeouts, permissions, status lines | | **Hooks** | 63 | Automation triggers | Conventional commits, blocking direct pushes | | **Mods** | 50 | Plugins that change Claude Code's own interface and behavior | Secret redaction, protected paths, terminal games | | **Loops** | 18 | Autonomous workflows with a goal, an interval and a stop condition | Docs sweep, build-test-fix, adversarial review | | **Templates** | 14 | Complete project configurations | Language and framework setups | | **Sandboxes** | 11 | Launchers that run Claude Code in an isolated environment (reference only, see [`cli-tool/components/sandbox/`](cli-tool/components/sandbox/)) | E2B, Cloudflare, Docker | | **Plugins** | 1 | Whole Claude Code plugins, installed from the `aitmpl` marketplace | Champion Kit | Live counts: [`dashboard/public/counts.json`](dashboard/public/counts.json). ## Local tools The CLI also ships three local tools. The two dashboards listen on `127.0.0.1` only, because they serve your conversation history. | Command | What it does | |---------|--------------| | `npx claude-code-templates@latest --analytics` | Real-time session monitoring and usage metrics at `localhost:3333` | | `npx claude-code-templates@latest --chats` | Read and search your conversations in a mobile-friendly UI at `localhost:9876` | | `npx claude-code-templates@latest --health-check` | Diagnose your Claude Code installation and project setup | To open the conversation browser from another device, forward the port over SSH: `ssh -L 9876:localhost:9876 `.
Flags removed in 1.31.0 `--plugins`, `--skills-manager`, `--command-stats`, `--hook-stats`, `--mcp-stats`, `--agents`, `--chats-mobile`, `--teams`, `--2025`, `--studio`, `--sandbox`, `--tunnel`, `--create-agent`, `--list-agents`, `--update-agent`, `--remove-agent` and `--clone-session` were removed. Running one prints what replaced it. To see what is installed in each scope, use the [stack viewer mod](https://www.aitmpl.com/component/mods/ui/stack-viewer) (`--mod ui/stack-viewer`, then `/stack` in Claude Code). Details in the [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md).
## Documentation Guides, the CLI reference and the catalog API live at **[docs.aitmpl.com](https://docs.aitmpl.com)**. ## Contributing Contributions are welcome. Read the [contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) to add a skill, agent, command, MCP, setting, hook or mod, and the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) before you open a pull request. ## Sponsors and programs ### Sponsors
